title: Addressing Both Statistical and Causal Gender Fairness in NLP Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating both statistical bias metrics (True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate, and Positive Prediction Rate gaps based on observational data) and causal bias metrics (using Counterfactual Data Augmentation by substituting explicit gender identity tokens) on occupation classification (BiasBios) and toxicity detection (Jigsaw) tasks.
